title: Marqeta and Coinbase Take Stablecoin Spending Mainstream
message_html: Marqeta and Coinbase Take Stablecoin Spending Mainstream ...
snippet: Marqeta’s enterprise customers can now offer stablecoin-backed cards powered by Coinbase, the companies said in a Friday (Oct. 16) press release. This offering is enabled by a new collaboration that integrates Marqeta’s card issuing platform with Coinbase’s infrastructure, according to the release.
